raw_definitions: Definisi : adj male, jantan: a ~ elephant, gajah jantan; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. male of a bovine animal, lembu jantan; 2. male of the elephant, whale, etc, /gajah, paus, dll/ jantan; 3. large solidly built person, orang yg besar /bagas, tegap/; 4. (Stock Exchange) bull: ~ market, pasaran bull ; 5. see BULL’S EYE; 6. see BULLDOG. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
